attchmntText: Urban Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 160256410 securities pursuant to Qualified Institution Placement
voiceSummary: Urban Company Limited has approved the allotment of 16,02,56,410 equity shares to qualified institutional buyers at an issue price of Rs. 156 per share. The total issue size is approximately Rs. 2,500 crore. The placement opened on November 16, 2026, and closed on November 19, 2026. The company's paid-up equity share capital has increased from 1,54,21,80,603 shares to 1,70,24,37,013 shares. The trading window, previously closed, will open effective November 22, 2026. Major allottees include mutual funds from SBI, ICICI Prudential, and Mirae Asset, along with Prazim Trading and Investment Co. Pvt. Ltd. and HDFC Life Insurance Company Limited. The shareholding pattern will be submitted with the listing application.

attchmntText: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited received a purchase order from Adani Energy Solutions Limited on 19 November 2026. The order is for the supply of 9,059.33 km of AL-59 conductors for the ±800 kV HVDC Bhadla–Fatehpur transmission project. The total value is Rs. 707.80 crore including GST, with a basic value of Rs. 599.83 crore excluding GST. Deliveries are to be completed by 31 December 2027. The pricing is on a commodity back-to-back basis, linked to LME aluminium prices and the USD/INR exchange rate. This order marks the company's entry into the HVDC transmission segment.

attchmntText: 3i Infotech Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: 3i Infotech Limited received a purchase order dated November 19, 2026, from a new domestic banking institution customer. The order is for IT Facility Management Services, onsite annual maintenance, software and security subscriptions, infrastructure support, and ISO certification. The contract covers the customer's data centre, disaster recovery environment, head office, and branch network. The committed term is three years, commencing on January 1, 2027, with potential mutual extension. The total purchase order value is Rs. 24.48 Crore, exclusive of applicable taxes. The customer's name is not disclosed due to confidentiality obligations. This information is filed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Highway Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Highway Infrastructure Limited received a Letter of Commencement from the Central Public Works Department on 19th November 2026. The order is for the planning, designing, and construction of residential and non-residential infrastructure for the CISF 12th Reserve Battalion at Village Jamunia Talab, Dist. Sehore, Madhya Pradesh. The project is executed on an EPC Mode-I basis. The contract duration is 2 Years. The total consideration for the order is Rs.1,98,30,99,984.08. The awarding entity is a domestic entity. There is no interest held by the promoter or promoter group companies in the entity that awarded the order. The order does not fall within related party transactions. This announcement is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Max Estates Limited has informed the Exchange about Subscription of 10% Non-Convertible, Non-Cumulative, Non-Participating Redeemable Preference Shares of Acreage Builders Private Limited.
voiceSummary: Max Estates Limited subscribed to 14,55,166 10% Non-Convertible, Non-Cumulative, Non-Participating Redeemable Preference Shares of Acreage Builders Private Limited on November 19, 2026. The subscription was made at par, with a face value of INR 10 per share. The aggregate cash consideration paid was INR 1,45,51,660. This transaction represents 100% of the preference shares offered under the rights issue. The event is classified as a related party transaction conducted on an arm's length basis. The subscription aims to augment Acreage Builders Private Limited's paid-up share capital to meet regulatory requirements for its commercial real estate project in Gurugram. Following this, the total paid-up share capital of the subsidiary is expected to increase to INR 2,00,00,000. Max Estates Limited retains approximately 51% equity shareholding in the subsidiary. The transaction is expected to be completed on or before November 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Capri Global Capital Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 3000 securities pursuant to Non Convertible Securities ECB Bonds at its meeting held on November 19, 2026
voiceSummary: Capri Global Capital Limited has approved the allotment of 3000 senior secured rated listed redeemable United States Dollar denominated non-convertible bonds through private placement. The bonds have a face value of USD10,000 each, aggregating to USD30,000,000, equivalent to INR2,799,600,000. The allotment was approved by the Management Committee of the Board of Directors on November 19, 2026. The bonds are proposed to be listed on NSE IFSC Limited. The tenure is 36 months from the date of allotment, with a maturity date of November 19, 2029. The coupon rate is 240 basis points plus Term SOFR. Interest is payable semi-annually. Principal repayment of 100 percent of the outstanding amount will be made in bullet on the maturity date. The bonds are secured by a first ranking pari-passu continuing charge by way of hypothecation over specific receivables of the Company in favor of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited.

attchmntText: Juniper Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about commissioning of additional capacity
voiceSummary: Juniper Green Energy Limited reports that its wholly owned subsidiary, Juniper Green ETA Five Private Limited, commissioned the entire 108.50 MWp solar component of its 75 MW wind-solar hybrid power project on November 19, 2026. This project operates under a Power Purchase Agreement with Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited. Following this commissioning, the aggregate operational capacity of Juniper Green Energy Limited and its subsidiaries stands at approximately 2,952 MWp and approximately 698 MWh BESS as of the date of the announcement. The company has submitted this update to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The intimation was signed by Prashant Pandia, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Juniper Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about commissioning of BESS Capacity
voiceSummary: Juniper Green Stellar Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Juniper Green Energy Limited, has commissioned 94.77 MWh Battery Energy Storage System capacity at the project site on November 19, 2026. This capacity is currently deployed as merchant capacity, with the option to shift to a long term power purchase agreement in the future. Following this commissioning, the aggregate operational capacity of Juniper Green Energy Limited and its subsidiaries stands at approximately 2,844 MWp and approximately 698 MWh BESS.

attchmntText: Tata Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Tata Technologies Limited has made the audio recordings of its Investor Day held on November 19, 2026, available on its website. This disclosure is pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The recordings feature presentations by Warren Harris, Anish Raghunandan, Nachiket Paranjpe, Kapil Bakshi, Nithin Thomas, and Uttam Gujrati. Specific topics include From Strength to Scale, Product Realization Excellence, Winning in Software, Aerospace as the Next Growth Engine, AI as a Force Multiplier, and Delivering Profitable Growth and Shareholder Value. The audio files are accessible via direct links provided in the announcement. The notice was issued by Raghav Mulay, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Dynamatic Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Factory Tour
voiceSummary: Dynamatic Technologies Limited intimates that its Investor and Analyst Factory Tour was successfully conducted on 19th November 2026 at JKM Plaza, Dynamatic Aerotropolis, Bengaluru. The event was organized to provide investors with first-hand insight into campus and factory operations, as the Annual General Meeting for FY 2025–26 was held via video conferencing. No presentation was made during the visit, and no unpublished price-sensitive information was shared. Snapshots of the tour have been uploaded to the company website.

attchmntText: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Merger of Turbo Health Holdings, LLC (step-down wholly owned subsidiary) with Inventurus Knowledge Solutions, Inc. (wholly owned subsidiary).
voiceSummary: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited disclosed that the Board of Directors of its wholly owned US subsidiary, Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Inc, approved the merger of Turbo Health Holdings LLC with Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Inc. This approval is subject to applicable laws in the United States of America. Turbo Health was incorporated on November 5, 2026, and purchased by Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Inc on November 10, 2026. The merger aims to streamline the corporate structure and consolidate operations. No cash consideration or new shares will be issued. The shareholding pattern of the listed entity remains unchanged. The disclosure was received on November 19, 2026, at 10:03 PM IST.
